## 简体中文

### 问答题库

- 知识库新增结构化问答题库，可编辑一级问题、答案及多条追问。
- 支持折叠展开、拖拽排序、题库文件导入，以及 AI 批量识别问题和答案。
- Windows 与 macOS 编辑器统一为圆角卡片布局，并为一级问题和追问提供独立删除操作。

### 问题反馈与诊断

- 设置中新增问题反馈中心，可提交文字说明、可选诊断日志和图片附件。
- 用户可查看历史反馈及 New、Under Review、Resolved 处理状态。
- 新增日志管理后台，支持搜索、筛选、查看、复制、下载日志和同步处理状态。

### 提示板与语音识别

- Windows 与 macOS 提示板支持拖拽移动，并记住上次选择的音频来源。
- 麦克风模式默认严格过滤更像候选人回答的识别文本；系统音频模式不监听麦克风。
- 下一题静音判断调整为 3.5 秒；答案展示后的前 20 秒内，疑似新问题只提示而不自动切换。
- 移除提示板按钮的悬浮提示，降低屏幕共享时泄露界面说明的风险。

### 体验与稳定性

- 修复 macOS 打开提示板时的队列断言崩溃，并改进提示板停靠与浮动切换。
- 改进 Windows 主窗口默认尺寸、设置页和面试页滚动性能。
- 改进本地 RAG 模型下载与校验，并继续将模型随安装包提供。

## English

### Q&A banks

- Added structured Q&A banks with primary questions, answers and multiple follow-ups.
- Added collapse/expand, drag reordering, question-file import and AI-assisted batch parsing.
- Unified the Windows and macOS editors around rounded cards with independent delete actions for primary and follow-up questions.

### Feedback and diagnostics

- Added a feedback center where users can submit a description with optional diagnostic logs and image attachments.
- Users can review previous reports and track New, Under Review and Resolved status.
- Added a log administration dashboard with search, filters, detail views, copy/download actions and status synchronization.

### Prompter and speech recognition

- Prompters are draggable on Windows and macOS and remember the last selected audio source.
- Microphone mode now always applies strict content-based candidate-speech filtering; system-audio mode does not listen to the microphone.
- Next-question silence detection is now 3.5 seconds. During the first 20 seconds of an answer, suspected new questions are surfaced without switching automatically.
- Removed button hover tooltips from the prompter to avoid exposing UI descriptions during screen sharing.

### Experience and reliability

- Fixed the macOS queue assertion crash when opening the prompter and improved docked/floating transitions.
- Improved the Windows default window size and scrolling performance on the Interview and Settings pages.
- Improved local RAG model download and verification while continuing to bundle the model with releases.
